decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because it is firmly within our established coolant-management offer and, absent clear evidence of results below internal or peer aspirations, our scale and slack justify continued commercialization.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge since it fits our core process-media portfolio and there is still no strong signal that its performance falls short enough to trigger withdrawal rather than continued learning.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor for now, but as a more adjacent product its results would be judged more critically against emerging aspiration levels and it would be a candidate for reallocation if performance disappoints.
We would keep the magnetic belt chip conveyor because it builds directly on our established conveying business and our engineering, service and sales network lower the need for an early exit.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor for now, though with elevated withdrawal risk relative to core products because adjacent launches face more uncertainty and are more exposed to problemistic search if returns lag aspirations.
